defects: Antitone hypothesis is stronger than gold: produced assumes `Antitone f` (antitone on all of ℝ) instead of gold's `AntitoneOn f (Ici 0)` (antitone only on [0,∞)), which narrows the class of functions the theorem applies to
Nonnegativity hypothesis is stronger than gold: produced assumes `∀ x, 0 ≤ f x` (nonneg everywhere) instead of gold's `∀ t ∈ Ioi 0, 0 ≤ f t` (nonneg only on (0,∞))
Integrability domain is `Ici 0` instead of gold's `Ioi 0`, a slightly stronger (superset) hypothesis
